meta.ImageDescription: Transmission electron micrographs of negatively stained Streptococcus thermophilus phages representing the five phage groups/genera. (I) Moineauvirus spp. (a. phage SW11, b. phage STP1; (II) Brussowvirus spp. (c. phage SW13, d. phage CHPC1057; (III) Vansinderenvirus spp. aka 5093 phages (e. phage 5093, f. phage SW27; (IV) Piorkowskivirus spp. aka 987 phages (g. phage 9871], h. phage CHPC926; (V) P738 phages (i. phage P738, j. phage D4446). The asterisks indicate the distal ends of the central tail fiber structures (of various lengths). The triangles show the globular appendages at the distal end of the 5093 phage tails. The (50 nm) scale bar is presented in panel e.
